meta.description: Company Profile seed data for CALA hospitality operators. Sources: company websites, BMV/FT filings, annual reports, LinkedIn (headcount ranges only). Logo intentionally omitted.

form.companyOverview: Remington Hospitality CALA is the Caribbean and Latin America division of Remington Hospitality, a U.S.-based third-party hotel management company founded in 1968. Following a strategic expansion into CALA in late 2022, Remington established a regional headquarters in Miami to support owners and asset managers across Costa Rica, Mexico, Puerto Rico, the Cayman Islands, Belize, Panama, Peru, and the Dominican Republic. The CALA portfolio includes existing and pipeline full-service, lifestyle, and resort properties under brands such as Kimpton, Hilton Garden Inn, Moxy, Autograph Collection, and LXR.

form.companyOverview: Highgate is a hospitality investment, management, technology, and development firm with a 30+ year track record across North America, the Caribbean, Latin America, and Europe. The company owns, develops, and manages hotels and resorts for institutional and private owners, with capabilities spanning revenue management, branding, ground-up development, adaptive reuse, renovations, and venture investments in hospitality-linked technology.

form.companyOverview: Driftwood Hospitality Management (DHM) is an award-winning third-party hotel management company headquartered in North Palm Beach, Florida. Founded in 1999, DHM manages 80+ hotels comprising approximately 15,000 rooms across North America, Latin America, and the Caribbean. The company supports owners in daily operations, acquisitions, development, renovations, and receiverships across full-service, resort, lifestyle, and select-service segments with major brands including Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG, and Wyndham.

form.companyOverview: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe, S.A.B. de C.V. (BMV: HOTEL) is a publicly listed Mexican hospitality company focused on acquiring, developing, and operating urban and beach hotels. The company operates proprietary Krystal brands (Krystal, Krystal Grand, Krystal Beach, Krystal Urban) and manages properties under international franchises including Hilton, Hyatt, and Accor. As of recent filings, GHSF operates hotels across major Mexican destinations such as Cancún, Los Cabos, Puerto Vallarta, Guadalajara, and Mexico City.

form.companyOverview: Grupo Presidente is a Mexican hospitality company with more than 50 years of experience operating full-service luxury and business hotels, restaurants, and retirement residences. The company is Mexico's master franchise partner for InterContinental Hotels Group (Presidente InterContinental, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Resort) and also represents Marriott and Hyatt brands. Its hotel portfolio spans major Mexican cities and beach destinations including Mexico City, Cancún, Cozumel, Puerto Vallarta, Los Cabos, Guadalajara, Monterrey, Mérida, and Puebla.

form.companyOverview: Grupo Posadas, S.A.B. de C.V. (BMV: POSADAS) is Mexico's largest hotel operator by room count, owning, leasing, franchising, and managing more than 200 hotels and 30,000+ rooms in Mexico and the Caribbean. Its brand portfolio includes Live Aqua, Fiesta Americana, Grand Fiesta Americana, Fiesta Inn, Gamma, One, and The Explorean, among others. The company operates a vertically integrated hospitality platform spanning hotel operations, vacation clubs, and third-party hotel administration.

form.companyOverview: Hoteles Estelar S.A. is one of Colombia's largest hotel companies, operating urban and vacation hotels under the Estelar brand across Colombia and Peru. Founded in 1968 and headquartered in Cali, the company manages convention hotels, city hotels, and beach properties in destinations including Bogotá, Medellín, Cartagena, Cali, Barranquilla, Santa Marta, Lima, and Paipa. Estelar also operates the InterContinental Cali under a branded-management relationship.

form.companyOverview: Oxohotel is a Colombia-based hospitality management group that designs, develops, and operates hotels, resorts, and lodging assets across multiple segments. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Bogotá, the company manages 30+ properties under global brands including Marriott, Hilton, and IHG, as well as independent and proprietary concepts. Oxohotel provides end-to-end services from project conceptualization through operations, with a growing focus on coliving, multifamily, and senior-living hospitality formats.

form.companyOverview: Decameron Hotels & Resorts is a Colombian all-inclusive hospitality company founded in 1987 by Lucio García. Headquartered in Bogotá, Decameron operates affordable beach and vacation resorts across Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Ecuador, Panama, El Salvador, Jamaica, and other CALA markets. The company integrates hotel operations with an in-house tour operator and vacation-club distribution channel.

form.companyOverview: Movich Hotels is a Colombian hotel chain founded in 2010, operating design-forward urban and leisure hotels across six Colombian cities including Bogotá, Medellín, Cartagena, Cali, Pereira, and Rio Negro. Known for distinctive interiors by Nini Andrade Silva and a strong gastronomy focus, Movich targets both business and leisure travelers with properties such as Movich Cartagena de Indias and Movich Buró.

form.companyOverview: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19, S.A.B. de C.V. (BMV: HCITY), formerly Hoteles City Express, is a Mexican hospitality platform that develops, operates, and franchises economy and midscale hotels across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Costa Rica. Following Marriott's acquisition of the City Express brand, Norte 19 continues as the operator of City Express by Marriott hotels and is expanding as a multi-brand operator with proprietary formats such as Hoteles HOTSSONE.
